data_point_evaluator:
Process "Option+price" data from a list (identified by "Index" and "data_point_name"). The "99acres" value is the reference; compare it against "Primary Source" for the same "Index" to generate matching scores.
Config price strings follow the format: "Config price strings follow the format: "Configuration (ex- 2 BHK) & Property Type (ex- Apartment=Flat=Penthouse=Pentsuites; Villas= villa=row houses; Plot=Residential Plot=Land; Studio Apartment=Studio=serviced apartments=bed studio=1 RK; Retail Shop=Shop) – Area Type (Carpet, Super area, Built up area) – Area (ex- 1850 sq ft, 700 sq mt) – Price (can be in Lacs/ Lakhs/ Lakh/ L or Crores/ Cr/ C)".
In  rows:
1. Each row will have multiple strings of data separated by "|".
2. In one string of data there will be multiple "Area Type" followed by their respective "Area" details. Compare that "Area Type- Area" from Comparable that matches with "Area Type- Area" of Reference.
3. If a particlar comparable is 'Not Available or N/A or NA', then the match against the value should be ignored.
4. If a ref value is 'Not Available or N/A or NA', then match is 0.
Task:
1. Standardize area (to sq ft) and price (to Crores).
2. For each comparable source, find the string with matching "Configuration & Property Type – Area Type – Area" ("Option Data").
3. Calculate "Option Matching Score" (1 if "Option Data" matches, 0 otherwise)
4. Calculate "Price Matching Score" only for those Comparable rows whose "Option Data" matches with the reference (1 if the price of the matched string is +/- 5% of reference price, 0 otherwise).
Give the Output in the form of a json with columns- Index, data_point_name, ref_value, Comparable Rows (give only that string of data from comparable value that is a match with reference) from all Comparable Sources, Option Matching score, Price Matching score. Do include those ref value rows in the output where the Matching score of option is 0. Do not give codes. Give "NA" as a result in output column "Comparable Row" where no comparable row data string matches with reference.
